For GTA5 enthusiasts, fat people are a prime target. Let me give you some reasons why.

First, they drop snacks AND money instead of just money (or money and occasionally ammo depending on NPC). Now money is always good, but snacks are quintessential to the game as they are the only way to swiftly replenish health.

Next up is improving stats. You can permanently improve stats like cardio, shooting, driving, flying, and strength in GTA5. Strength though, is a bit of a pain in the ass to do. You need to physically hit a character (or vehicle with a person in it) several times to raise your strength stat. There are simply not better targets for raising this stat than fat people. They are slow, so easy to catch up with, and absorb lots of damage to their fluffy exterior before expiring, allowing you to train your strength stat excessively.
